title: Rich Harris: Futuristic Web Development
summary: Rich Harris's Svelte Summit 2020 talk on what a modern web development workflow could look like. It announced that Sapper would give way to what became SvelteKit.
why: Cited as the source for Sapper's end and SvelteKit's origin, and as an early view of where JS frameworks were heading.

quote.text: I really do believe this is the next phase of how JS web frameworks will work in the future.
